Numbeo Nov 2026: 3BR EUR 1,348 outside centre, EUR 1,594 centre. Pet-friendly listings carry a premium; no VAT on residential rent.

electricity.notes: Iberdrola/Endesa. A/C significant May–Sep (90°F summers). Electric heating in winter mild.

gas.notes: Natural gas or butano (propane canister ~€15/refill). Mild winters, less heating needed.

water.notes: AMAEM (Alicante municipal water). Includes alcantarillado (sewage). Tiered rates, water scarcity surcharges.

sewage.notes: Included in water bill as alcantarillado.

utilities.taxes: IVA included in bills: 10% on electricity, 10% on gas, 10% on water/sewage.
utilities.notes: Electricity: PVPC average bill EUR 88/mo for a 3,500 kWh/yr household in Oct 2026 (+26% y/y, papernest); a 2-3BR with summer A/C runs about EUR 100-120. Butane cylinder EUR 15.46 (1-2/mo). Water/sewer (AMAEM) about EUR 35 incl. alcantarillado; trash in rent. Numbeo Alicante basic utilities EUR 125 (90-160). Excludes internet.

healthcare.notes: Resident retiree couple age 60 on private full-cover policies (required for the non-lucrative visa; pre-existing conditions can be loaded or excluded). Poliza Medica Nov 2026 market average at age 60: EUR 91/person full cover with copays, EUR 123/person no-copay; Sanitas Mas Salud 60-64 no-copay EUR 186 (Valencia) to EUR 220 (Barcelona) per person. Typical = 2 x EUR 123; after 1 year of legal residency the public SNS becomes an option via the convenio especial (not priced here). Max uses Sanitas Valencia-region 60-64 no-copay x2.
